name: ai-video-generator
description: A full-stack web application that converts text prompts or image uploads into AI-generated videos

scripts.install-all: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../frontend && yarn install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && uvicorn server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --reload" "cd frontend && yarn start"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && echo 'Ready for deployment'
scripts.setup: cp -n backend/.env.example backend/.env; cp -n frontend/.env.example frontend/.env; echo 'Created backend/.env and frontend/.env. Add RUNWAY_API_KEY to backend/.env for real videos.'
scripts.app: cd frontend && yarn build && cd ../backend && uvicorn server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001
